format_scope_note: ⛔ CAPA B (sub-género horror-choice) — NO universal. NUNCA usar en sport-choice / editorial / tutorial / B2B. Disponible solo bajo `--format horror-choice`. Autoridad: horror-choice-format/PAUTA-MASTER.md § 2.4. Va aquí (horror-choice-format/effects-library/transitions/), NO en la Capa A universal (ai-video-production/templates/effects-library/), per README effects-library rule #2 ('sub-genre → <format>-format/effects-library').
native_mechanism_note: LOSSY: the real recipe is a multi-stage filter_complex (sepia/grain base + pixelation + chromatic aberration + scanlines + frame-tear/datamosh-lite + hlslice xfade). `xfade=transition=hlslice` is the closest single-primitive approximation used by apply-effects-between-clips.py — the digital-error decoration (pixel blocks, RGB split, scanlines, tear) is NOT reproduced by the bare xfade. Use the full ffmpeg_recipe for the canonical look; the chained-xfade fallback loses the error aesthetic.
description: Story-CHANGE glitch for horror-choice: the screen reads as an OLD, pixelated screen 'with an error / signal corruption' for ~0.4s at narrative seams (recorrido transitions, decisión→consecuencia, branch bridges, played↔counterfactual). Base = parque-acuatico V3 look (sepia + grain + contrast + warm hue-shift + glitch xfade + `glitch_warm` sting) PLUS a stronger digital-error layer: blocky pixelation + chromatic aberration (RGB split) + scanlines + a frame-tear/datamosh-lite horizontal slice. Reads as 'the recording of this night is corrupting' — distinct from D29 decision-freeze (freeze + sepia is the LESS pronounced version; this is the MOST pronounced, reserved for the actual change of story/path).
base_reference: parque-acuatico V3 — transición `glitch` (xfade) + SFX sting `glitch_warm` + filtro CSS de reconocimiento/cambio `sepia(0.45) contrast(1.22) hue-rotate(-12deg) saturate(0.85)`. V7+ lo lleva más digital-error/pixelado (este recipe).
digital_error_layers: pixelation: blocky downscale→upscale (scale w/16:h/16:flags=neighbor → scale back nearest-neighbor) during the seam, eased in/out
chromatic_aberration: RGB channel split with ±6-10px horizontal offset on R vs B channels (lutrgb split + overlay)
scanlines: faint horizontal dark lines (geq / drawgrid 1px every 3px at ~18% opacity)
frame_tear_datamosh_lite: one horizontal slice (~12-20% band) shifted ±20-40px for 1-2 frames (crop+overlay band)

ffmpeg_params.glitch_start: Set = duration(clip_a) - 0.4 (the seam where the story changes).
ffmpeg_params.glitch_end: Set = duration(clip_a) (end of the error burst, just before clip_b takes over).
ffmpeg_params.fade_out_start: Set = duration(clip_a) - 0.12 (quick audio fade-out on clip_a before the sting).

audio_recipe: acrossfade 0.4s on the base + the `glitch_warm` sting layered at the seam. `glitch_warm` = drone-tension.mp3 bit-crushed warm (NOT cold/cyberpunk): pre-process with `ffmpeg -af 'chorus=0.7:0.9:55:0.4:0.25:2,aresample=8000,aresample=44100,acrossfade'` for a warm low-fi crush. Mix at volume 0.40 (Capa B sting band), peak placed at glitch_start + 0.1s so the audio error feels causal with the visual tear.
audio_processing_hint: Warm (not cold) bitcrush: `ffmpeg -i drone-tension.mp3 -af 'chorus=0.7:0.9:55:0.4:0.25:2,aresample=8000,aresample=44100' glitch-warm.mp3`. The 8kHz downsample = old-screen lo-fi grit; the chorus keeps it warm vs the clinical RGB-glitch sting.
use_cases: (a) STORY/RECORRIDO CHANGE A↔B (PAUTA-MASTER § 2.4): cambio de recorrido de personajes, branch bridges (rama A muerte → rama B retorno, pairs with caption 'SI ELEGISTE B'), played path ↔ counterfactual jump (the imagined cozy timeline corrupting back to the night)
(b) DEATH moments (consequence-A FATAL): the cut into the fatal body-horror beat — the recording 'corrupts' as the viewer dies
decisión → consecuencia boundary (the MORE pronounced version vs D29 freeze+sepia)
avoid_for: ⛔ ANY non-horror-choice format (sport-choice / editorial / tutorial / B2B) — Capa B scope violation
Inside a single continuous emotional moment (use cross-fade-0.5s)
The decision FREEZE itself (use the D29 freeze + sepia filter — this glitch is for the CHANGE, not the pause)
More than ~1x per story-change beat / overuse across the reel — exhausts the 'corruption' impact
The hook single-shot (feedback_hook_continuity_no_zoom_cut: no cuts inside the hook)
relation_to_d29: D29 decision-UI = freeze + sepia filter for the DECISION PAUSE. `old_screen_glitch_error` is the MOST pronounced variant, reserved for the actual CHANGE OF STORY / recorrido. Same warm sepia DNA, escalated with digital-error layers.
hyperframes_alternative: CSS+GSAP: at the seam, tween `filter: sepia(0.45) contrast(1.22) hue-rotate(-12deg) saturate(0.85)` + a stacked layer with `image-rendering:pixelated` on a downscaled frame + a repeating-linear-gradient scanline overlay (1px black @ 0.18 every 3px) + a brief `transform: translate(±8px,0)` RGB-split pseudo-elements (text-shadow / mix-blend) + one clipped horizontal band translated ±30px for 2 frames. Schedule glitch_warm sting at the seam volume 0.40.
canonical_observations: Per glitch-transition.json (Capa A) + static-noise-transition.json: digital glitch is NOT an inter-clip transition in the 8 F1 refs (caption-level glitch/flicker appears in 4/8 refs as red-text overlay only). This recipe is NOT claimed as F1-canonical inter-clip; it is an AUTHORED Capa B horror-choice effect mandated by PAUTA-MASTER § 2.4 (Tomás 2026-06-01 enhancement) with parque-acuatico V3 as the design referent (our own production, story-change beats). Use it where the SPEC explicitly declares a story-change seam — NOT as a default cut (the default cut stays hard-cut-with-whoosh, 8/8 canonical).
validated_notes: Capa B authored effect (PAUTA-MASTER § 2.4). Base = parque-acuatico V3 glitch+sepia+glitch_warm; V7+ adds pixelation + chromatic aberration + scanlines + frame-tear. Sting volume 0.40 within hard rule #9 SFX band. Reserve for story-change seams only; the decision pause keeps the softer D29 freeze+sepia.
